items.title: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro®) for managing obesity – patient leaflet
Counterfeit weight loss jabs worth £2m seized in Birmingham raid
items.summary: More than 12,000 counterfeit weight loss medicine jabs worth around £2m have been seized in a raid on an industrial unit in Birmingham.

items.title: ASA clamps down on rule-breaking pharmacy weight-loss medicine adverts
items.summary: The Advertising Standards Agency (ASA) has clamped down for the first time on online promotion of oral weight loss drugs. It found two online pharmacies had broken the rules by promoting unlicenced medicines and prescription-only medicines to the public in adverts for oral GLP-1 treatments.

items.title: Oral weight loss medicine ads banned by watchdog
items.summary: The Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) has ruled that adverts from two online pharmacies broke the rules by promoting oral GLP-1 weight loss medicines to the public. The rulings are the watchdog’s first involving oral GLP-1 weight loss medicines and concern ads from Simple Online Pharmacy and Pharmacy Online.

items.title: CVD benefits of semaglutide not fully explained by weight loss
items.summary: The cardiovascular benefits of the GLP-1 receptor agonist semaglutide cannot be fully explained by weight loss or improvements in other known risk factors, according to a new analysis of a major clinical trial.

items.title: Attending a community weight management organisation during pregnancy: a service evaluation
items.summary:
Background/Aims
A nutritious diet, regular physical activity and minimising excess weight gain are key during pregnancy.

items.title: Evidence is ‘reassuring’ for women who become pregnant while taking GLP-1 drugs
items.summary: Exposure to GLP-1 weight-loss and diabetes drugs around conception does not appear to be linked to a detectable increase in adverse outcomes for mothers or babies, a large review of the evidence has concluded.

items.title: Study finds no evidence of harm from GLP-1 exposure during pregnancy
items.summary: Women who accidentally become pregnant while taking a GLP-1 treatment for diabetes or weight loss are not at increased risk of miscarriage or other complications of pregnancy, according to new research.

items.title: GLP-1s and SGLT-2s may help slow kidney damage in diabetes, study shows
items.summary: Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists and sodium glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT-2) inhibitor drugs slow decline in kidney function in people with type 2 diabetes, but the benefits are only seen if they also have albuminuria, a large US ‘real-world’ study has reported.

items.title: Semaglutide linked to 40% reduction in asthma attacks
items.summary: Weight loss and diabetes treatment semaglutide is associated with a nearly 40% reduction in asthma attacks among people with the condition, according to new analysis.

items.title: UK watchdog rebukes Eli Lilly over GLP-1 press release sent to BBC
items.summary: A UK watchdog found an Eli Lilly GLP-1 press release sent to the BBC used 'promotional and emotive' language and brought discredit on the pharmaceutical industry, per Fierce Pharma.
